browserReproductions: Original scripts run unchanged against a local static server on their documented port 8766. Final before/after logs are exact commands, without any port remapping.

findings.defaultBehavior: Air-finale gate blocks mission completion, while repair, buoy drift/pickup, emergency supply and combat input continue; no new aircraft, clock frozen.
findings.rollback: navalAirEnd=v24 still wins immediately after fleet completion.
findings.risk: בינוני: פעולות הקרב והתחזוקה נמשכות כעת גם בסיום האווירי; שעון המשימה נשאר קפוא וסיום השלב מחכה לשמיים נקיים.
findings.before: HP 6.5→6.5, repair charges 3→3; supplies=0 and belt=0 despite steering into the buoy.
findings.after: HP 6.5→8, repair charges 3→2; supplies=1, belt=160, buoy removed; standalone regression also waits for a genuine final win.
findings.probeNote: Original defect assertions require unchanged HP, charges, supplies=0 and belt=0, so the corrected code intentionally fails them. A read-only measurement rerun records those assertions without changing model inputs. Its pre-update closest-distance sampler misses the collection frame (16.216m before the step); the new regression samples both sides of that step and confirms radius crossing, pickup and replenishment.

findings.defaultBehavior: Native semantic clicks (detail=0) pulse the switch; pointerdown remains immediate and the following pointer click does not add a pulse. AbortController removes both handlers.
findings.rollback: The existing arsenal flag removes the switch in the session; even an isolated directly-mounted switch preserves its previous pointer-only behavior with alienArsenal=0.
findings.risk: נמוך: click סמנטי בלבד נוסף; native pointer click לא מוסיף הפעלה נוספת, keyC והתעלמות מקלט טקסט נשמרו.
extraChecks: Immediate pointerdown followed by click has one onGesture and one pulse
KeyC works; focused text input ignores it
Native Chromium Enter and Space, no synthetic-only DOM test

findings.defaultBehavior: Written help and both narration paths use one key selector. Six added Hebrew translation keys preserve default wording and select truthful rollback wording.
findings.rollback: reviewHelp=0 returns precisely the original three keys per game. Existing gameplay flags select matching rollback help by default.
findings.risk: נמוך: מיפוי טקסט בלבד, ללא שינוי כללי משחק או API הקריינות. אין שינוי במפתחות התרגום הקיימים.
findings.before: Rollback models had pit.on=false/auto=false and radarOn=false/airEnd=false, but help promised an automatic pit every race, timed radar acquisition and waiting for aircraft.
findings.after: Pit rollback help limits stops to races of three laps or more; radar rollback uses the v24 immediate-lock text; air-end rollback omits waiting for aircraft. Displayed text equals announced/narrated keys for independent flag combinations.
findings.probeNote: The unmodified original asserts the presence of incorrect help and therefore exits 1 after the fix. An additional python3 -O run prints the exact same browser/model measurements with defect assertions disabled; the new node --test assertions independently validate the corrected contracts.
